name: ad/bumper-6s
description: Six-second bumper: one visual idea (a product capture under a short headline), one slow push, then a static end card with the brand lockup and the CTA from 4.0 s to 6.0 s.

headline.doc: The one idea, five words at most. On screen from 0.15 s.

cta.doc: The CTA on the end card (accent pill).

image.doc: Product capture under assets/ (build --assets). Optional: without it the headline carries the shot.

imageFocus.doc: CSS object-position for the capture crop.

imageZoom.doc: Crop zoom into the capture in portrait and square (1 = fitted by cover).

url.doc: Short domain beside the CTA on the end card, optional.

legal.doc: Optional legal line on the end card.
